name: multi-region-latency-benchmarker
title: Multi-region Latency Benchmarker
description: An edge ping diagnostic utility testing real-time connection latencies against Frankfurt, Virginia, Tokyo, and Singapore.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Ping Benchmark Execution: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
